Interface CoinsAPI

All Superinterfaces:
com.atomictempest.core.economy.Economy
public interface CoinsAPI extends com.atomictempest.core.economy.Economy
Coins for other plugins. Most plugins only need what every economy offers: use Economies.get() and your plugin works with Coins and with any VaultUnlocked economy alike. Use this when you need what only Coins has: 
CoinsAPI coins = CoinsAPI.get();          // null when Coins is not installed
if (coins != null) {
    coins.transfer(buyer, seller, 250, "Horse sale");
}
Declare "AtomicTempest:Coins": "*" under OptionalDependencies (or Dependencies) in your manifest.json so Coins starts first. Amounts are whole numbers of the smallest coin; every change shows in the player's wallet history with the reason you give. Everything here is safe to call from any thread.

    • setBalance

      void setBalance(UUID player, long amount)
      Sets a balance outright (never below 0). Shows in the history as "Set by an admin".

    • transfer

      boolean transfer(UUID from, UUID to, long amount, String reason)
      Moves money from one player to another. The payer's history says "Paid: reason", the payee's "Received: reason".
      Returns:
      false, moving nothing, when the payer has too little, the amount is 0 or less, or both are the same player

    • paidAsCoins

      default void paidAsCoins(UUID player, long amount, String reason)
      Records coins your plugin paid out as coin items instead of into the wallet (a machine's tray, a drop), so the economy screen and the leaderboards count them. The balance does not change. Since VERSION 4.
      Parameters:
      reason - as for a wallet change, such as "Slot machine win"; it decides the kind the economy screen shows
